prompt: Decide recursively whether a string reads the same forwards and backwards by comparing the end characters and recursing inward. Complete the isPalindrome method, then run the tests.
explanation: The recursion shrinks the string from both ends at once: if the outer characters differ the answer is immediately false, and if they match the question reduces to the inner substring. Two base cases collapse into one -- both the empty string and a single character are trivially palindromes, so length <= 1 returns true. substring(1, length - 1) is the standard way to strip one character from each end.
hints: Base case: any string of length 0 or 1 is a palindrome, so return true when s.length() <= 1.
Compare s.charAt(0) with s.charAt(s.length() - 1); if they differ, return false right away.
If they match, the answer is isPalindrome of the middle: s.substring(1, s.length() - 1).
